component.name: Edgeline
component.summary: Picture, touch and a dashboard for the Corsair Xeneon Edge

description.p: The Corsair Xeneon Edge is a 14.5 inch 2560x720 touchscreen that ships with no Linux software at all: Corsair's iCUE is Windows only and will not run under Wine. Edgeline is a native replacement.

ul.li: Picture control over DDC/CI: brightness, contrast, sharpness, colour presets, per channel gain and blanking, all driven from the panel's own reported capabilities
Touch handling: four modes, and a five point calibration that shows its residual error before writing anything
A dashboard on the panel itself, with clock, CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network and failed unit tiles
Profiles, and per application rules that switch between them on window focus

description.p: No kernel module and no root daemon. Picture control goes through ddcutil, touch through xinput, and the agent runs as your own user.

Rebuilt around an Electron interface, with the C++ becoming a headless agent that owns the panel. New name, four themes, and pages for picture, touch, the dashboard, profiles, settings and developer tools. Adds profiles, per application rules, ICC awareness and a calibration routine that reports its error before applying.
Documented the touch stack and proved the panel does full multi touch on Linux. Added a touch diagnostic and an update check.
Close to tray, a dashboard toggle, and a full static analysis cleanup.
First release: DDC display control, touch modes and calibration, HID recon, and the Edge dashboard.
